def hasAllCodes(s, k):
    return all(bin(i)[2:].zfill(k) in s for i in range(1 << k))

def minOperations(n):
    # Initialize the array with the given formula
    arr = [i * 2 + 1 for i in range(n)]
    # Initialize the difference array with the differences between adjacent elements
    diff = [arr[i + 1] - arr[i] for i in range(n - 1)]
    # Initialize the count of operations
    count = 0

    # Iterate until the difference array has only one element
    while len(diff) > 1:
        # Find the index of the maximum difference
        max_index = diff.index(max(diff))
        # Increment the count of operations
        count += 1
        # Update the difference array
        diff = [diff[i] - diff[max_index] for i in range(len(diff)) if i != max_index]

    return count
